[](https://skills.sh/maddhruv/pristine) [](/maddhruv/pristine/blob/main/site/public/og.png) An agent skill that makes web UI pristine. It looks at the real page (light and dark, desktop and mobile), judges it through the eyes of the people who use your product, and either scores it honestly or fixes it. Works with Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and any agent that reads SKILL.md. Site and examples: <https://pristineui.pages.dev Before (3.5/10) After one /pristine polish (9.5/10) [](/maddhruv/pristine/blob/main/site/public/shots/saaslanding/before/desktoplight.webp) [](/maddhruv/pristine/blob/main/site/public/shots/saaslanding/after/desktoplight.webp) Eight real before/after pairs, with the full critique and every change: <https://pristineui.pages.dev/examples Commands Command What it does Edits code /pristine init Reads your code, asks only what it can't see, and writes DESIGN.md: product, Personas, brand, design system. yes /pristine critique <target Scores a page out of 10 across 11 Dimensions, through each Persona, with the exact fix for every finding. no /pristine design <brief Builds a new page, component or flow, or redesigns one in a new direction. yes /pristine polish \[lenses\] <target Keeps the look and raises every detail. The default for a bare /pristine on existing UI. yes A target can be a URL, a pasted screenshot, a file path or a feature name. Name Lenses after polish to force them, for example /pristine polish bolder typeset the hero. There are 16: bolder, colorize, typeset, quieter, decolorize, distill, layout, adapt, consistency, animate, delight, overdrive, clarify, harden, optimize, polishdetails. Full reference with examples: <https://pristineui.pages.dev/docs/ Install Claude Code /plugin marketplace add maddhruv/pristine /plugin install pristine@pristine Codex codex plugin marketplace add maddhruv/pristine codex plugin add pristine@pristine GitHub Copilot (CLI and VS Code) copilot plugin marketplace add maddhruv/pristine copilot plugin install pristine@pristine Any agent (skills.sh) npx skills add maddhruv/pristine By hand git clone https://github.com/maddhruv/pristine ~/pristine ln s ~/pristine/skills/pristine ~/.claude/skills/pristine or ~/.copilot/skills, ~/.agents/skills Then, in your project, run /pristine init once and /pristine on whatever you're building. Screenshots Pristine captures pages before it judges them. It uses a browser tool your agent already has (Claude in Chrome, an agent browser, Playwright MCP). If there is none, scripts/capture.mjs installs a private Playwright Chromium into ~/.cache/pr

items.descZh: Pristine 是一款面向 AI 编程助手的插件，旨在通过模拟真实用户视角来评估和优化网页界面。它支持 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot 等主流 Agent，能够自动分析页面在亮色/暗色模式、桌面/移动端下的表现，并从 11 个维度进行打分与修复。其核心能力包括初始化项目并生成设计系统文档、对现有页面进行多角色批判、从零构建或重塑组件，以及在保留原风格的前提下打磨细节。该工具提供 16 种可选“透镜”（如加粗、配色、排版、简化等），允许开发者按需精细调控视觉方向。根据官方示例，一次 /pristine polish 可将页面评分从 3.5/10 提升至 9.5/10，效果显著。它适用于从新项目设计到旧项目重构的全流程，尤其适合追求极致用户体验的开发团队。

items.descZh: quantized.uk 是一个专为本地和边缘计算部署设计的开源分析工具，旨在帮助用户精准评估大语言模型（LLM）在特定硬件上的运行可行性。该平台的核心功能是提供覆盖78种GPU和Mac芯片的硬件选择器，结合4K上下文和严格的VRAM计算公式，为用户的聊天、编码或多模态任务推荐最匹配的量化模型及具体运行指令。数据库当前收录了117种量化模型，支持GGUF、AWQ、EXL2等多种格式，其中Q4_K_M量化格式在79个模型中的质量保留中位数高达97.1%，平均质量损失仅为1.4%至5.2%。以RTX 4060 Ti 16GB显卡为例，系统能清晰展示运行Mistral Small 24B（占用13GB，剩余2.8GB，质量损失3.8%）或Falcon 3 10B（占用7.3GB，剩余8.7GB）的具体显存余量，并给出如Qwen2.5 0.5B高达540 tok/s的极速吞吐量参考。无论是8GB显存的入门新手、需要多模态支持的开发者，还是追求高吞吐量的极客，该工具都能提供基于真实数据的量化选型指南。
items.quote: 选择你的显卡，查看117个量化大语言模型中哪些真正适合它——在哪个量化级别、还剩多少显存，以及运行每个模型的命令。

[](/tensemem/tensemem/blob/main/docs/banner.png) TenseMem Memory that knows its tenses. Embedded, deterministic memory that AI agents can safely act on. One SQLite file. No server required. The model proposes typed facts; the engine decides what is current. pip install tensemem from tensemem import FakeExtractor, Memory mem = Memory(llm=FakeExtractor()) mem.register_predicate("lives_in") added = mem.add("u1", "I live in Delhi") ctx = mem.context(user_id="u1", min_seq=added.seq, wait=1.5) print(ctx.text) fenced block the model can read print(ctx.freshness.is_current) True once extract finished FakeExtractor is rulebased and needs no API key. Same API with tensemem[openai], tensemem[anthropic], tensemem[ollama], tensemem[litellm], or Gemini (GEMINI_API_KEY in the process environment). Why this exists Similarity search returns both “I live in Delhi” and “I moved to Bangalore” and leaves the model to guess. TenseMem keeps one current value per slot, says whether the read is fresh, and refuses to learn from its own output. One current truth per ONE slot. A new city supersedes the old one. History still answers “where did I live before?” Every read reports freshness. as_of_seq, pending, is_current. Wait for a message, or see that it is not applied yet. No selfecho. Recalled context() is fenced. Extract needs a verbatim quote from the user. Corrections stick. correct() restores the displaced value and survives rebuild() with a newer model. The engine decides. The LLM emits typed ops. Deterministic rules apply them. No infrastructure. Default store is one SQLite file inside your process. Delhi, then Bangalore mem.add("u1", "I live in Delhi") mem.set(user_id="u1", predicate="lives_in", value="Bangalore") print(mem.state("u1").values) {"lives_in": "Bangalore"} history = mem.history("u1", predicate="lives_in") ACTIVE Bangalore, SUPERSEDED Delhi bangalore = next(f for f in history.facts if f.object == "Bangalore") mem.correct(bangalore.id) that move was never true print(mem.state("u1").values) {"lives_in": "Delhi"} flowchart LR E[episodes] X[extractor proposes ops] X R[resolver] R F[facts] F C["context() + freshness"] C .fence stripped X Loading Architecture Eve
items.author: shubh-singh
items.descZh: TenseMem 是一款专为 AI 代理设计的嵌入式、确定性状态记忆引擎，旨在解决传统相似性搜索中因新旧事实冲突（如同时存在“居住在德里”和“搬到了班加罗尔”）而导致模型猜测的痛点。其核心机制是“模型提议、引擎决策”，由 LLM 发出类型化操作，而由确定性规则引擎维护每个槽位唯一的当前事实，并完整保留历史轨迹以回答过往问题。该工具无需部署服务器，仅通过一个 SQLite 文件即可在进程内实现零基础设施运行，并提供精确的新鲜度报告（如 `is_current`、`as_of_seq` 和 `pending`），确保读取的数据新鲜可控。此外，它支持无密钥的规则提取器及多种主流大模型后端，并允许通过 `correct()` 恢复误判事实，确保修正状态在模型重建后依然持久。适用于需要强状态一致性、高可追溯性及低运维成本的 AI 智能体开发与多轮对话场景。
items.quote: 由引擎决定。LLM 输出类型化操作。确定性规则应用它们。

The iqiqgame.com homepage is where you play puzzles. This page is the solver index: 17 interactive tools that take the puzzle in front of you and return the next best move, the full solution path, or every valid answer. 17 solvers100% freeno signupruns in your browser [Sliding Puzzle Solver Solve 3x3 to 9x9 Sliding Puzzles Online](/solver/slidingpuzzlesolver)[Sumplete Solver Free Online Sumplete Puzzle Solver](/solver/sumpletesolver)[Mulplete Solver Free Online Mulplete Puzzle Solver](/solver/mulpletesolver)[24 Game Solver Free Online 24 Points Solver](/solver/24gamesolver)[Make 10 Solver Free Online Make 10 Puzzle Solver](/solver/make10solver)[Futoshiki Solver Free Online Futoshiki Puzzle Solver](/solver/futoshikisolver)[Sudoku Solver Free Online Sudoku Puzzle Solver](/solver/sudokusolver)[Lights Out Solver Free Online Lights Out Puzzle Solver](/solver/lightsoutsolver)[Killer Sudoku Solver Free Online Killer Sudoku Puzzle Solver](/solver/killersudokusolver)[Wordle Solver Free Online Wordle Puzzle Solver](/solver/wordlesolver)[KenKen Solver Free Online KenKen Calcudoku Puzzle Solver](/solver/kenkensolver)[Kakuro Solver Free Online Kakuro Puzzle Solver](/solver/kakurosolver)[Klotski Solver Free Online Klotski Huarong Dao Solver](/solver/klotskisolver)[Mastermind Solver Free Online Mastermind & Bulls and Cows Solver](/solver/mastermindsolver)[Skyscraper Solver Free Online Skyscraper Puzzle Solver](/solver/skyscrapersolver)[Takuzu Solver Free Online Takuzu Binairo Puzzle Solver](/solver/takuzusolver)[Matchstick Equation Solver Free Online Matchstick Puzzle Solver](/solver/matchstickequationsolver) What Is a Puzzle Solver? A puzzle solver is an interactive tool that takes the current state of a puzzle — its tiles, digits, cages or clues — and returns the next best move, a complete solution path, or every valid answer. Solvers work by computation and deduction, not by guessing, so a result is either a correct solution or a clear statement that the entered state cannot be solved. Sliding Puzzle Solver — finds a minimummove sequence for any 3×3 to 9×9 sliding tile board. Sumplete Solver — marks which cells to delete so every row and column hits its target sum. Mulplete Solver — handles the multiplication variant — it picks the cells to keep so rows and columns reach their target products. 24 Game Solver — lists every way to combine four numbers with +, , × and ÷ to make 24. Make 10 Solver — finds the digit and operator combinations that produce 10. Futoshiki Solver — fills a Latinsquare grid while obeying every lessthan and greaterthan sign. Sudoku Solver — completes any Sudoku grid from the given digits. Killer Sudoku Solver — solves grids where dotted sum cages replace the standard given digits. Lights Out Solver — returns a minimal toggle sequence that switches every light off. Wordle Solver — narrows the candidate list after each guess and suggests the strongest next word. KenKen Solver — solves calcudoku grids where cages carry +, , × and ÷ targets. Kakuro Solver — fills the crosssum grid so every horizontal and vertical run matches its clue. Klotski Solver — plans the slidingblock moves that free the large block (Huarong Dao). Mastermind Solver — tracks remaining candidates and proposes the next guess for Mastermind and Bulls and Cows. Skyscraper Solver — fills the grid so the visibleskyscraper counts match every clue around the edge. Takuzu Solver — completes binary grids with no threeinarow and balanced colors (Binairo). Matchstick Equation Solver — tells you which matchsticks to move to make a false equation true. Why Use a Puzzle Solver? A solver is not a replacement for solving. It is the fastest way to check whether you are on the right track, and the clearest way to learn the technique behind a puzzle you could not finish. Verify your answer. Finish the puzzle yourself first, then let the solver confirm it in seconds. Break a deadlock. One empty corner with two candidate numbers — the solver tells you which is right and why. Learn the technique. Stepbystep output shows the order experienced players use, from scan to final fill. Check solvability. Enter an arbitrary state and learn whether it has a solution at all before spending time on it. How to Use a Solver on iqiqgame.com 1. Pick the solver that matches your puzzle from the index or the comparison table below. 2. Enter the current state — tiles, digits, cages, clues or the words already played. 3. Run the solve and read the result: a completed grid, a move list, or all valid answers. 4. Apply the result in the live game on iqiqgame.com if you want to finish the puzzle with your own hands. items.title: Show HN: GrillMyProfile – AI roast of your LinkedIn, scored against a job
items.desc: description: Drop your LinkedIn PDF or paste the text for a free Profile Score and roast in 30 seconds, aimed at the job you want. Then the $19 Fix Pack rewrites your headline, About, experience and 5 posts. Score goes up or your money back. GrillMyProfile Get grilled. Get hired. Drop your LinkedIn PDF or paste the text. In about 30 seconds you get a Profile Score out of 100, a roast you'll want to share, and the three things costing you interviews. Paste the job you want and the whole thing is aimed at it. Drop a PDFPaste the text Drop your LinkedIn PDF here or click to choose a file · PDF only · up to 5 MB and 6 pages \+ Aim it at a job: paste the posting (optional) No email needed. We delete your file immediately. Only the text is read, and it's gone within 24 hours. Leaving the military? [Start with a free civilian draft of your profile](/military), jargon translated, then get grilled. What a score looks like Three example profiles. Yours is probably somewhere in between. The Buzzword Buffet31/100 Headline5/25 About7/25 Experience12/30 Clarity7/20 “Your headline has six nouns and no verb. It's not a title, it's a word cloud.” The Duty List58/100 Headline16/25 About13/25 Experience17/30 Clarity12/20 “Responsible for managing appears four times. We get it. You were there.” Almost There84/100 Headline22/25 About21/25 Experience25/30 Clarity16/20 “Numbers everywhere, which is great. Now tell us what you actually want next.” How it works 1. 1 Drop your PDF, or paste the text On LinkedIn, open the Resources menu under your name (More on some accounts) and choose Save to PDF. On a phone, just copy your profile and paste it. A resume works too. 2. 2 Add the job you want (optional) Paste the posting and your score, roast and fixes are aimed at that job, not at LinkedIn in general. 3. 3 Roasted, then promoted Score and roast are free. The $19 Fix Pack rewrites the weak parts and writes your next 5 posts. Score goes up or your money back. Roasted, then promoted. The roast is free. The Fix Pack is $19, one time, and it's the finished profile, not a hint. ✓3 headline options a hiring manager would click ✓A rewritten About section with a hook and real results ✓Every experience bullet rewritten around outcomes ✓5 readytopost LinkedIn updates in your voice ✓A PDF of all of it, by email, yours to keep Score goes up or your money back. Reupload after the fixes and watch it climb. Questions Is it really free?+ Yes. The score, the roast and the share card cost nothing. Only the Fix Pack, which rewrites your profile, is $19 one time. No subscription. What happens to my file?+ We extract the text and delete the PDF immediately. The text and your results are kept for 24 hours so your link works, then deleted. Paid Fix Packs are kept for good, so you can always come back to them: bookmark the link, keep the PDF email, or use Find my Fix Pack. Will the roast be mean?+ Sharp, not cruel. It roasts the writing, never the person: nothing about appearance, age, background, health or gaps in your history. Every roast passes a safety check before you see it. What is in the Fix Pack?+ Three new headlines, a rewritten About section, your experience bullets rewritten with results, and five readytopost LinkedIn updates. Delivered on screen and by email as a PDF. If you pasted a job posting, all of it is written for that job. What is the scoregoesup guarantee?+ Apply the fixes, then use the recheck link on your results page to upload the new version. If your score isn't higher than before, write to support within 14 days and we refund the $19. What does pasting a job posting do?+ The score judges your profile against that job, the roast goes after the gap between what the posting asks for and what you show, and the Fix Pack rewrites everything to make the case for that role. Skip it and you get a general LinkedIn review. Do you change my LinkedIn for me?+ No. We never log in to your LinkedIn, so nothing is changed for you. The Fix Pack gives you the finished text with a Copy button on each piece: paste the headline into your headline, the About into About, and each bullet into its job. It takes about five minutes. Then use the recheck link to see your new score. The full walkthrough is on the stepbystep page. Do you scrape LinkedIn?+ No. You upload the PDF LinkedIn makes for you. We never log in to LinkedIn or visit your profile. How is the score calculated?+ Headline (25), About (25), Experience (30) and Clarity (20). The same profile with the same target job gets the same score every time, so you can reupload after edits and see the difference. Ready? Scroll up and drop your PDF or paste your text, or read how we handle your data first. [Grill my profile](top)[Stepbystep guide](/guide)[Privacy](/privacy)[Find my Fix Pack](/fixpack/find)
